response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced fullstack engineer (15+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js depth, recent hands-on AI-agent and MCP tooling work, and a demonstrable testing-first culture — all closely matching the role's core needs. Note that he is currently employed at re:cinq, so this may be an internal candidate. Main gaps are the absence of explicit Nest.js and Kotlin experience and a frontend history weighted more toward Ember.js than React, but his polyglot background suggests these are learnable quickly.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js fullstack experience across product and platform work
Recent AI-agent development experience (MCP code generators, agentic workflow frameworks)
Strong testing and craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, authored test frameworks, ran testing workshops)
concerns: No Kotlin experience; Java exposure appears limited and dated
Frontend background leans heavily on Ember.js rather than React

key_factors.factor: Missing Nest.js and limited React/Kotlin exposure
